intended_use: Proposed initial descriptive fixed-library replay of exact-100 assay-positive recovery, conditional on fully adjudicated labels. Future decision: select 100 compounds for independent dose-response and orthogonal confirmation. Existing confidence-bound qualification gates remain separate, unchanged and unmet; descriptive points cannot satisfy them.
prohibited_uses: Affinity, selectivity, therapeutic or safety claims
Confirmatory outcome access before verified custody and protocol freeze
Retrospective target switching or score retuning
Substitution of descriptive point comparisons for confidence-bound qualification
Assay-version fallback or pooling without a prospective amendment
Claiming a replay-exposed library as untouched holdout for an inferential plan chosen after its outcomes

endpoint.quantity: retrieval of recorded quality-controlled inhibitory assay positives
endpoint.label_units: binary assay-positive status; unknown is separate
endpoint.target_definition: Human ALDH1A1 P00352; reference sequence version 2 matches AAP35567.1; actual assay construct remains unverified
endpoint.organism_and_population: Homo sapiens taxon 9606; eligible-library population not yet curated or frozen
endpoint.assay_and_conditions: Prospectively adopt PubChem AID 1030 version 2 revision 1, as verified in retained returned description objects, for the proposed design. Propionaldehyde/NAD+ reaction and NADH fluorescence; preserve source conditions. Historical 1.1 remains unauthenticated. Raw outcome-release binding, actual experimental construct and assay suitability remain unverified.
endpoint.label_transform: AC50 in micromolar and maximum inhibition in percent require verified source field, sign, QC and unit mapping; unresolved; complete descriptive replay requires adjudicated binary labels for every declared library member, otherwise insufficient evidence
endpoint.positive_class_definition: QC inhibitory concentration response with AC50 <=10 micromolar AND maximum inhibition >=50 percent. Inconclusive or unresolved optical interference remains unknown.

method.training_data_disclosure: No training routine in candidate; historical developer exposure must be disclosed, not assumed absent. Existing parameters remain unchanged.
method.stochastic_policy: Deterministic ascending score. Label-independent canonical identity SHA256 tie-break specified in design-decisions.json; no score rounding or tie expansion.

baselines_and_comparisons: Descending RDKit 2025.3.3 QED.qed with WEIGHT_MEAN, same eligible population and exact budget 100
Uniform random selection without replacement; primary expected yield 100*A/N, not a selected random draw

primary_gates.estimand_and_population: Difference in recorded positive yield per 100 from common frozen eligible pool; inferential population unresolved
primary_gates.rationale: User-defined proposed minimum five additional assay positives per 100 selected

primary_gates.estimand_and_population: Heuristic precision divided by eligible-population positive fraction; inferential population unresolved
primary_gates.rationale: User-defined proposed minimum twice expected random hit yield

secondary_analyses: Selection overlap, coverage, unknown-label attrition, series concentration and subgroup diagnostics; subgroup confirmatory rules unresolved

Initial descriptive report: exact h, q, N, A, overlap, precision difference and enrichment; operational point comparisons at 0.05 and 2.0 do not discharge primary confidence-bound gates; no sampling inference is claimed
